Completers vs. non-completers at baseline, d (p)

Note. Characteristics of the pooled baseline sample are n (%) or M (SD); race percentages are of the full baseline sample. Outcomes are on their analysis scales: frailty, the proportion of eligible deficits; cognition, the BTACT composite; allostatic load, the mean of 16 biomarker z scores. Completers are Wave 1 participants with the outcome observed again at Wave 2; d is the standardized baseline difference between completers and non-completers (completers minus non-completers, pooled SD), with Welch t-test p. Machine-learning samples exclude complete twin pairs for frailty and cognition and retain them for allostatic load (Table S18 reports models holding them out). Within-family ranges run from the 9-year change to the cross-sectional pair count (Table S4). The PhenoAge benchmark sample was n = 836. BTACT = Brief Test of Adult Cognition by Telephone; MZ = monozygotic.
ᵃ Observed for 6,634 (Hispanic ethnicity) and 6,643 (education) participants; education is the MIDUS 12-category credential code.
